label: Bible Study
prompt: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the _____ of the law.
verse: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
note: Love never harms a neighbour — which is why it fulfils the whole law.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: There is none holy as the LORD: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any _____ like our God.
verse: There is none holy as the LORD: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.
note: Hannah's song of thanks: none holy as the LORD, and no rock like our God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Is not this the _____, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
verse: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
note: Nazareth shrugged him off as the local carpenter — Mark is the only Gospel that gives Jesus himself that title.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a _____ land.
verse: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
note: Isaiah's portrait of a righteous king: shade from a great rock in a dry, exhausted land.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having _____ ears;
verse: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
note: 'Itching ears' — audiences who shop for teachers that scratch where it itches. Paul's forecast for Timothy.
